question: I would like to know the given names of baseball players who have achieved the highest value of games played, runs, hits, and home runs, with their corresponding score values.
sql:
SELECT p.name_given, b.g, b.r, b.h, b.hr, TRY_CAST(b.g AS INTEGER) + TRY_CAST(b.r AS INTEGER) + TRY_CAST(b.h AS INTEGER) + TRY_CAST(b.hr AS INTEGER) as score
FROM batting b
JOIN player p ON b.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE TRY_CAST(b.g AS INTEGER) + TRY_CAST(b.r AS INTEGER) + TRY_CAST(b.h AS INTEGER) + TRY_CAST(b.hr AS INTEGER) = (
    SELECT MAX(TRY_CAST(g AS INTEGER) + TRY_CAST(r AS INTEGER) + TRY_CAST(h AS INTEGER) + TRY_CAST(hr AS INTEGER))
    FROM batting
    WHERE g IS NOT NULL AND r IS NOT NULL AND h IS NOT NULL AND hr IS NOT NULL
)
